name: QEF Boundary Constrained Vertex Placement
definition: A fallback strategy for vertex placement when the optimal solution to a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) lies outside the current voxel cell. It progressively constrains the search space from the interior point to cell faces, then edges, then corners to find a valid point within the cell boundaries.
summary: QEF Boundary Constrained Vertex Placement ensures Dual Contouring vertices remain within voxel cells by hierarchically constraining the Quadratic Error Function to planes, edges, or corners when the optimal solution lies outside.
